integrity: The proof separates the literature inputs from the new orbit-identification step and does not treat finite computation as proof of the infinite classification.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies realized unary automorphism orbits, not all complete 1-types of the theory.
No higher-arity orbit enumeration is claimed.
The all-n generator classification is taken from the cited one-generated Heyting-algebra literature; the bundled computation checks only finite initial cases.
source_ids: Citkin, One-Generated WS5-Algebras, Advances in Modal Logic 12 (2018), 143-158
title: The Rieger–Nishimura ladder is the unary orbit spectrum of the universal finite-Heyting Fraïssé limit
